title: CAD/CAM Training Data Extraction — PDF/Video Knowledge Harvest for Action Learning
brief: Extract procedural knowledge, tribal tips, and action sequences from all available CAD/CAM training materials. This milestone MUST complete BEFORE CADCAM-DAGI-MS1 (CAD Software Action Learning) to ensure the AGI has learned HOW to use each software before attempting to draw. Strategic priority: Mastercam first (JM Die primary system), then Inventor (5,082 files), then others.

rationale.why_before_action_learning: The AGI cannot learn to draw in software X without first understanding HOW software X works - menus, commands, workflows, keyboard shortcuts, parameter meanings. These PDFs contain that procedural knowledge.
strategic_order: Mastercam FIRST - JM Die has 9,337 Mastercam files, it's their primary CAD/CAM
Inventor SECOND - 5,082 Inventor files in system, 11+ InventorCAM training PDFs available
hyperMILL THIRD - Already extracted 434 tips, but consolidate into action sequences
SolidWorks/Fusion/FreeCAD FOURTH - Lower file counts, but complete coverage required
rationale.extraction_method: /pdf-learn for PDFs, /video-learn for any video tutorials found

files: David Planchard - Engineering Graphics with SOLIDWORKS 2021-SDC Publications (2021).pdf

hypermill.action: Consolidate existing extractions into action sequences
